drivers.name: Promotion: 30% off
drivers.evidence: Deeper discount than past promotions (max 25% off). Past 30% off (2025-09-08) had x1.26 lift, but during back-to-school season. Noise-adjusted uplift from 8 past promotions: x1.02. Adjusted to x1.10 for deeper discount and post-season timing.

drivers.name: Supplier delivery risk
drivers.evidence: Planner note warns of short delivery. No past evidence of supply issues. Introduced downside risk, but not confirmed. Shrunk toward 1.0 due to uncertainty.

adjustment.analysis: The 30% off promotion is deeper than past promotions (max 25% off), but the product has no prior 30% off history. The noise-adjusted uplift from 8 past promotions is only x1.02, and the 2025-09-08 30% off week saw x1.26, but that was during back-to-school season. The target week is post-season, so no seasonal lift. The supplier warning introduces supply risk, but no past evidence of delivery issues. The classical model suggests x1.02, but this underweights the new discount depth. Adjust to x1.10 with wider upside due to uncertainty. No trend or seasonality in baseline. The 'ordinary week' noise is 77%, so shrink toward 1.0. Confidence is medium due to limited past 30% off data.

brief:
PRODUCT: Sunscreen SPF50 | category Personal Care | Store #12 (Austin, TX)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: Promotion: 30% off
  shelf price: 9.75 (-27.1% vs regular price 13.38)
  planner notes: Supplier warns of a short delivery

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 24.9 | 5%-95%: 0.0 - 64.6 | 10%-90%: 1.6 - 44.4

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-77% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
